settings.html:
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Heebo:wght@300;400;500;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:84px}
body{background:#0B0B0C;direction:rtl;margin:0;overscroll-behavior-y:none}
.syx{--gold:#F5B83D;--gold2:#FFD27A;--ink:#0B0B0C;--ink2:#111113;--card:#151518;--line:rgba(245,184,61,.18);--text:#F4F1EA;--mute:#A9A59B;
 --out:cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1);--inout:cubic-bezier(.77,0,.175,1);
 font-family:"Heebo",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--text);direction:rtl;text-align:right;line-height:1.6;
 -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale;overflow-x:clip;position:relative;isolation:isolate}
.syx *,.syx *::before,.syx *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
.syx h1,.syx h2,.syx h3,.syx p{margin:0}
.syx img{display:block;max-width:100%}
.syx a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.syx :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold2);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:8px}
.syx .wrap{width:min(1200px,100% - 40px);margin-inline:auto}
.syx h1,.syx h2,.syx h3{text-wrap:balance}
.syx p{text-wrap:pretty}
.syx .eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase}
.syx .eyebrow::before{content:"";width:28px;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold))}
.syx .gold{background:linear-gradient(100deg,var(--gold) 20%,#fff1c9 50%,var(--gold) 80%);background-size:220% 100%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;animation:syxShine 6s linear infinite}
@keyframes syxShine{to{background-position:-220% 0}}

/* progress + header */
.syx-progress{position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto 0;height:3px;z-index:1002;background:transparent;pointer-events:none}
.syx-progress i{display:block;height:100%;width:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--gold2));transform-origin:100% 50%;transform:scaleX(0);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(245,184,61,.7)}
.syx-head{position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto 0;z-index:1001;transition:background-color .3s ease,box-shadow .3s ease,transform .45s var(--out)}
.syx-head.is-solid{background:rgba(8,8,9,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--line)}
.syx-head.is-hidden{transform:translateY(-100%)}
.syx-head .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;height:72px}
.syx-logo img{height:42px;width:auto}
.syx-nav{display:flex;gap:6px}
.syx-nav a{position:relative;padding:12px 16px;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;color:#d8d4ca;border-radius:999px;transition:color .2s ease,background-color .2s ease}
.syx-nav a.is-on{color:var(--gold2);background:rgba(245,184,61,.1)}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.syx-nav a:hover{color:#fff}}

/* buttons */
.syx .btn{--bx:0px;--by:0px;position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:52px;padding:0 30px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:800;font-size:17px;border:1.5px solid var(--gold);cursor:pointer;
 transform:translate(var(--bx),var(--by));transition:transform .35s var(--out),box-shadow .3s ease,background-color .2s ease,color .2s ease;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;font-family:inherit}
.syx .btn:active{transform:translate(var(--bx),var(--by)) scale(.97)}
.syx .btn-gold{background:var(--gold);color:#111;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(245,184,61,.32),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
.syx .btn-gold::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(105deg,transparent 30%,rgba(255,255,255,.6) 50%,transparent 70%);transform:translateX(120%);transition:transform .8s var(--out)}
.syx .btn-ghost{background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);color:var(--gold2);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.syx .btn svg{width:18px;height:18px;transition:transform .35s var(--out)}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){
 .syx .btn-gold:hover{box-shadow:0 14px 44px rgba(245,184,61,.5),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6)}
 .syx .btn-gold:hover::after{transform:translateX(-120%)}
 .syx .btn:hover svg{transform:translateX(-5px)}
 .syx .btn-ghost:hover{background:rgba(245,184,61,.12)}
}
.syx .btn-sm{min-height:44px;padding:0 22px;font-size:15px}

/* hero */
.syx-hero{position:relative;min-height:100svh;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:120px 0 90px;overflow:hidden;background:#08080a}
.syx-hero .bg{position:absolute;inset:-6% -2%;background:url(https://nivcreative.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/shay-hero-stage.webp) 22% 8%/cover no-repeat;will-change:transform;transform:translate3d(var(--px,0),var(--py,0),0) scale(1.08)}
.syx-hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;background:linear-gradient(270deg,rgba(8,8,10,.97) 8%,rgba(8,8,10,.8) 42%,rgba(8,8,10,.15) 75%,rgba(8,8,10,.55)),linear-gradient(0deg,#0B0B0C 0,transparent 22%)}
.syx-hero .spot{position:absolute;z-index:2;width:560px;height:560px;left:0;top:0;margin:-280px 0 0 -280px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(245,184,61,.22),transparent 62%);mix-blend-mode:screen;pointer-events:none;transform:translate3d(var(--sx,50vw),var(--sy,40vh),0);will-change:transform;opacity:0;transition:opacity .6s ease}
.syx-hero.is-live .spot{opacity:1}
.syx-hero canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none}
.syx-hero .wrap{position:relative;z-index:3}
.syx-hero .copy{max-width:660px}
.syx-hero h1{font-size:clamp(40px,7vw,92px);line-height:1.02;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:20px 0 22px}
.syx-hero h1 .w{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;padding-bottom:.12em;margin-bottom:-.12em}
.syx-hero h1 .w>span{display:inline-block}
.syx-hero .lead{font-size:clamp(17px,1.7vw,21px);color:#d9d5cb;max-width:520px;font-weight:300}
.syx-hero .lead b{color:#fff;font-weight:700}
.syx .rot{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:26px 0 34px;font-size:clamp(20px,2.4vw,28px);font-weight:700}
.syx .rot .win{position:relative;height:1.4em;overflow:hidden;min-width:7ch}
.syx .rot .win span{position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto 0;color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(110%);opacity:0;transition:transform .7s var(--out),opacity .5s ease}
.syx .rot .win span.on{transform:none;opacity:1}
.syx .rot .win span.off{transform:translateY(-110%);opacity:0}
.syx .cta-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px}
.syx .trust{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 22px;margin-top:38px;font-size:14px;color:var(--mute)}
.syx .trust li{list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.syx .trust{padding:0}
.syx .trust li::before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--gold)}
.syx .scrollcue{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:50%;bottom:26px;translate:-50% 0;width:26px;height:44px;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);border-radius:20px}
.syx .scrollcue::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:8px;left:50%;width:4px;height:8px;margin-left:-2px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--gold);animation:syxCue 1.8s var(--out) infinite}
@keyframes syxCue{0%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}80%,100%{transform:translateY(16px);opacity:0}}

/* marquee */
.syx-marq{border-block:1px solid var(--line);background:#0e0e10;padding:18px 0;overflow:hidden;direction:ltr;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 12%,#000 88%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000 12%,#000 88%,transparent)}
.syx-marq .track{display:flex;gap:48px;width:max-content;animation:syxMarq 38s linear infinite}
.syx-marq:hover .track{animation-play-state:paused}
.syx-marq span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:48px;font-size:clamp(22px,3vw,34px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(245,184,61,.55);white-space:nowrap}
.syx-marq span::after{content:"✦";font-size:.6em;color:var(--gold);-webkit-text-stroke:0}
@keyframes syxMarq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

/* sections */
.syx section.sec{position:relative;padding:clamp(72px,10vw,130px) 0}
.syx h2.t{font-size:clamp(32px,4.8vw,60px);line-height:1.08;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:16px 0 18px}
.syx .sub{font-size:clamp(17px,1.6vw,20px);color:#c9c5bb;font-weight:300;max-width:640px}

/* where are you now */
.syx-pick{background:radial-gradient(900px 400px at 85% 0,rgba(245,184,61,.08),transparent 60%),var(--ink)}
.syx .tabs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin:34px 0 26px}
.syx .tab{min-height:48px;padding:0 24px;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);color:#e8e4da;font:600 16px/1 "Heebo",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .25s ease,color .25s ease,border-color .25s ease,transform .25s var(--out)}
.syx .tab:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.syx .tab[aria-selected=true]{background:var(--gold);color:#111;border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(245,184,61,.3)}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.syx .tab:not([aria-selected=true]):hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold2)}}
.syx .panelbox{position:relative;min-height:230px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:28px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#17171a,#101012);padding:clamp(24px,4vw,48px);overflow:hidden}
.syx .panelbox::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto auto -40% -10%;width:60%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(245,184,61,.14),transparent 65%)}
.syx .pane{position:relative;display:grid;gap:14px;max-width:760px;animation:syxPane .6s var(--out) both}
.syx .pane[hidden]{display:none}
.syx .pane h3{font-size:clamp(22px,2.6vw,32px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.syx .pane p{color:#cfcbc1;font-size:18px;font-weight:300}
.syx .pane .btn{justify-self:start;margin-top:8px}
@keyframes syxPane{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);filter:blur(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none}}

/* about */
.syx-about .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:clamp(30px,6vw,90px);align-items:center}
.syx .photo{position:relative;border-radius:32px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:4/5;clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0 round 32px);box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 0 0 1px rgba(245,184,61,.2)}
.syx .photo img{width:100%;height:118%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 38%;will-change:transform;transform:translate3d(0,var(--ty,0),0) scale(1.05)}
.syx .photo::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(11,11,12,.7),transparent 45%)}
.syx .photo .tag{position:absolute;z-index:2;right:22px;bottom:22px;left:22px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:10px}
.syx .photo .tag b{font-size:22px;font-weight:800}
.syx .photo .tag small{color:var(--gold2);font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
.syx .stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:34px}
.syx .stat{padding:18px 16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025)}
.syx .stat b{display:block;font-size:clamp(34px,4vw,48px);font-weight:900;color:var(--gold);line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.syx .stat span{font-size:14px;color:var(--mute)}
.syx .about-p{display:grid;gap:16px;margin-top:6px;color:#d2cec4;font-size:18px;font-weight:300}
.syx .about-p b{color:#fff;font-weight:700}

/* program */
.syx-prog{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--ink),#0e0e10 50%,var(--ink))}
.syx .cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:48px;perspective:1100px}
.syx .card{--rx:0deg;--ry:0deg;--gx:50%;--gy:50%;position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:430px;border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--card);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);
 transform:rotateX(var(--rx)) rotateY(var(--ry));transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .5s var(--out),border-color .3s ease,box-shadow .4s ease;will-change:transform}
.syx .card .im{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:cover;background-position:center;opacity:.55;transition:opacity .5s ease,transform .8s var(--out)}
.syx .card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(11,11,12,.97) 28%,rgba(11,11,12,.35) 75%,rgba(11,11,12,.6))}
.syx .card::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s ease;background:radial-gradient(260px circle at var(--gx) var(--gy),rgba(255,226,160,.22),transparent 70%)}
.syx .card .body{position:relative;z-index:3;margin-top:auto;padding:24px;display:grid;gap:10px}
.syx .card .n{font:800 13px/1 "Heebo";letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--gold)}
.syx .card h3{font-size:24px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.syx .card .k{display:inline-block;width:fit-content;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(245,184,61,.14);color:var(--gold2);font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
.syx .card p{color:#cbc7bd;font-size:15.5px;font-weight:300}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){
 .syx .card:hover{border-color:rgba(245,184,61,.5);box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 0 40px rgba(245,184,61,.12)}
 .syx .card:hover .im{opacity:.8;transform:scale(1.07)}
 .syx .card:hover::after{opacity:1}
 .syx .card{transition:transform .12s linear,border-color .3s ease,box-shadow .4s ease}
}

/* tracks (mental + business) */
.syx .tracks{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;margin-top:48px}
.syx .track2{position:relative;padding:clamp(26px,4vw,46px);border-radius:28px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(155deg,#18181b,#0f0f11);overflow:hidden}
.syx .track2::before{content:"";position:absolute;width:320px;height:320px;top:-160px;left:-120px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(245,184,61,.18),transparent 65%);transition:transform .8s var(--out)}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.syx .track2:hover::before{transform:translate(120px,80px) scale(1.3)}}
.syx .track2 h3{position:relative;font-size:clamp(26px,3vw,36px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-bottom:6px}
.syx .track2 .tl{position:relative;color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}
.syx .track2 ul{position:relative;list-style:none;margin:22px 0 0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:14px}
.syx .track2 li{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;color:#d4d0c6;font-size:17px;font-weight:300}
.syx .track2 li::before{content:"";flex:none;margin-top:9px;width:18px;height:2px;background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--gold)}

/* journey */
.syx-path .head{max-width:640px}
.syx .pathgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:40px;align-items:start;margin-top:60px}
.syx .bignum{position:sticky;top:26vh;display:grid;justify-items:center;text-align:center;gap:6px;pointer-events:none}
.syx .bignum b{display:block;font-size:clamp(200px,24vw,380px);line-height:.9;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.06em;color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:2px rgba(245,184,61,.7);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 40px rgba(245,184,61,.25))}
.syx .bignum b.flip{animation:syxFlip .7s var(--out) both}
.syx .bignum span{font-weight:800;font-size:20px;color:var(--gold2)}
@keyframes syxFlip{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px) scale(.94);filter:blur(10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 40px rgba(245,184,61,.25))}}
.syx .steps{position:relative;margin-top:0;display:grid;gap:34px;padding-inline-start:0}
.syx .rail{position:absolute;top:10px;bottom:10px;right:27px;width:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden}
.syx .rail i{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold),var(--gold2));transform-origin:50% 0;transform:scaleY(var(--p,0));box-shadow:0 0 16px var(--gold)}
.syx .step{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:56px 1fr;gap:26px;align-items:start;opacity:.35;transition:opacity .6s ease}
.syx .step.on{opacity:1}
.syx .dot{position:relative;z-index:1;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#0B0B0C;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);font-weight:900;font-size:18px;color:var(--mute);transition:border-color .5s ease,color .5s ease,box-shadow .6s ease,background-color .5s ease}
.syx .step.on .dot{border-color:var(--gold);color:#111;background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(245,184,61,.12),0 0 30px rgba(245,184,61,.5)}
.syx .step .box{padding:6px 0 10px}
.syx .step h3{font-size:clamp(22px,2.6vw,30px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.syx .step p{margin-top:6px;color:#c6c2b8;font-size:17px;font-weight:300;max-width:640px}
.syx .step small{display:inline-block;margin-top:10px;color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.1em}

/* videos */
.syx-vid{background:#0e0e10}
.syx .vids{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;margin-top:44px}
.syx .vid{position:relative;display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;border:0;padding:0;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;background:#000 center/cover no-repeat;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(245,184,61,.2);isolation:isolate}
.syx .vid::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(0,0,0,.65),rgba(0,0,0,.1) 60%)}
.syx .vid .play{position:absolute;inset:0;margin:auto;width:78px;height:78px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(245,184,61,.5);animation:syxPulse 2.4s var(--out) infinite;transition:transform .35s var(--out)}
.syx .vid .play svg{width:28px;height:28px;margin-left:-3px;fill:#111}
.syx .vid:active .play{transform:scale(.94)}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.syx .vid:hover .play{transform:scale(1.1)}}
@keyframes syxPulse{70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 24px rgba(245,184,61,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(245,184,61,0)}}
.syx .vid iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0}

/* faq */
.syx-faq .list{margin-top:40px;display:grid;gap:12px;max-width:860px}
.syx details{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-radius:20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);transition:border-color .3s ease,background-color .3s ease}
.syx details[open]{border-color:rgba(245,184,61,.45);background:rgba(245,184,61,.05)}
.syx summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;min-height:64px;padding:14px 24px;font-size:clamp(17px,1.8vw,20px);font-weight:700}
.syx summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.syx summary i{position:relative;flex:none;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--gold)}
.syx summary i::before,.syx summary i::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;margin:auto;width:12px;height:2px;background:var(--gold);transition:transform .35s var(--out)}
.syx summary i::after{transform:rotate(90deg)}
.syx details[open] summary i::after{transform:rotate(0)}
.syx details .ans{padding:0 24px 22px;color:#cdc9bf;font-size:17px;font-weight:300;animation:syxPane .5s var(--out) both}

/* contact */
.syx-contact{background:var(--ink);text-align:center}
.syx section.sec.syx-contact{padding-bottom:0}
.syx-formcont{background:radial-gradient(800px 420px at 20% 100%,rgba(245,184,61,.16),transparent 60%),var(--ink);padding:0 0 clamp(72px,10vw,120px)}
.syx-contact h2.t{margin-inline:auto;max-width:820px}
.syx-contact .sub{margin-inline:auto}
.syx-formwrap{width:min(560px,100% - 40px);margin:34px auto 0;padding:clamp(20px,3vw,34px);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:28px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#17171a,#0f0f11);box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.syx-formwrap .elementor-field-textual{min-height:52px}
.syx-formwrap .elementor-button{width:100%;min-height:54px}
.syx-note{margin-top:14px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mute)}

/* footer */
.syx-foot{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:30px 0;background:#080809}
